title: AI Manifest Schema — JuanStack AI Secretary
description: Defines the contract for both core.ai-manifest.json (dannflow universal states) and {vertical_id}.ai-manifest.json (vertical-specific extensions). The AI Secretary's task-engine.ts reads and validates manifests against this schema at startup.

manifest_version.description: SemVer string for this manifest file. Used for compatibility checks.

vertical_id.description: Present only in vertical-specific manifests. Must match business.json → vertical_id.

extends.description: Present only in vertical-specific manifests. Path to the core manifest this one extends.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this manifest covers.

observable_states.description: List of database states the AI Secretary monitors. Each state, when triggered, creates a SecretaryTask for the human.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this observable state. Used as the triggered_by_state_id in secretary_tasks table.

table.description: The Supabase table to observe. The AI Secretary has READ-ONLY access — never write access.

trigger_field.description: The specific column in the table that is evaluated against the trigger_condition.

trigger_condition.description: The condition evaluated against trigger_field. Supported patterns: 'equals: {value}', 'within_{N}_days', 'within_{N}_hours', 'is_null', 'is_not_null', 'greater_than: {value}'.

semantic_meaning.description: Plain-English explanation of what this trigger means in business context. Used by the AI to generate natural language task descriptions.

suggested_task.description: The default task description shown to the human. May include template variables like [case_id], [invoice_number], [client_name].
examples: Draft a polite follow-up email to the client.
Remind the lawyer to prepare documents for Case #[case_id].
Auto-generate the 2551Q draft and prompt the lawyer to review.

priority.description: Task priority level. critical = requires immediate attention (e.g., court hearing in 72h). high = same-day action needed. medium = action within the week. low = informational.

cooldown_hours.description: Optional. Minimum hours before this state can trigger the same task again for the same record. Prevents notification spam. Default: 24.

requires_confirmation.description: Optional. If true, the AI Secretary must ask the user for confirmation before taking any suggested action. Default: true.
